title: Things Fall Apart
author: Chinua Achebe
summary: Okonkwo, a proud and fiercely driven man in a Nigerian Igbo village, tries to build a name for himself as the community's traditions are shaken by the arrival of colonial missionaries and officials.
readIf: you want a short, classic of African literature that shows a society from within before and after colonial contact.
skipIf: you want a lighter read; it is spare, grim and doesn't soften its hero.

pairings.reason: A later Nigerian novel on a different crisis, with more characters and a wider emotional range.
Another novel about outsiders reshaping an African community, told from the outsiders' side.
Another novel about tradition, power and a family in a postcolonial world.
